decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: High once converted into diversified liquid holdings (e.g., U.S. Treasuries yielding 4.69% 5-Yr / 4.91% 10-Yr / 5.30% 30-Yr as of Nov 24, 2026), but immediately reduced by transaction & tax friction.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: Moderate — liquid capital can be redeployed across asset classes, though starting principal is smaller after federal + CA + transfer taxes.
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Sale proceeds may be reduced by transaction costs, applicable transfer taxes, and owner-specific income tax. The City of Los Angeles publishes Measure ULA thresholds/rates; tax liability and gain character require CPA analysis. A short remaining lease may affect buyer pricing, but no broker quotes are available in this workspace.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: Eliminates single-asset LA earthquake, wildfire, and JACK tenant bankruptcy exposure immediately at closing; shifts risk to broader financial markets.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Verified tax basis is relatively high, expected price avoids the Measure ULA cliff (or parcel is outside LA City), owner prioritizes liquidity/de-risking, and store closure risk is elevated.
decisionOptions.sourceLabel: IRS Topic 409, CA FTB, LA Finance ULA, U.S. Treasury

decisionOptions.option: Sell Before Short-Lease Cliff — IRC §1031 Tax-Deferred Exchange (or DST)
decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: High — defers federal & conforming CA capital gain and Sec. 1250 depreciation recapture while diversifying into longer-WALT, higher-credit, geographically dispersed real property.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: Moderate to High — keeps pre-tax equity compounding (note: LA County/City transfer taxes, Measure ULA, and brokerage fees are NOT deferred by §1031).
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Strict IRS 45-day written identification and 180-day closing deadlines via Qualified Intermediary; Measure ULA cash drag if applicable; reinvestment risk under tight deadlines.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: Substantially reduces single-site LA seismic (60% 30-yr ≥M6.7 USGS probability), California wildfire/insurance, and single-tenant JACK exposure if diversified out of state.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Low tax basis with large embedded capital gain/depreciation, owner wants passive wealth preservation without paying immediate federal+CA income taxes, and WALT still attracts institutional buyers.

decisionOptions.option: Negotiated Early Renewal / 'Blend-and-Extend' (Hold or Sell Post-Extension)
decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: Moderate to High ONLY IF corporate guaranty & healthy store economics are verified — repairs WALT, reduces short-lease buyer discount, and preserves Prop 13 base year value.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: High optionality — can unlock a higher sale valuation after extending lease term or sustain cash flow without triggering immediate income tax or Measure ULA.
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Tenant may seek rent relief or TI contribution given AB 1228 ($20/hr wage) and JACK's negative SSS (-4.2% FY25; -1.1% Q3 FY26); C-suite turnover (Nov 2026 8-K) may slow negotiations.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: Extends LA seismic/wildfire concentration AND keeps owner exposed through JACK's May 2031 ($500M 7.624% Series 2026-1) and Feb 2032 ($503M Series 2022-1) debt ARDs.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Private store sales confirm healthy rent coverage, lessee/guarantor is Corporate or well-capitalized multi-unit franchisee, and broker BOVs confirm post-extension value uplift exceeds concessions.
decisionOptions.sourceLabel: JACK Q3 FY26 10-Q, Nov 2026 8-K & LA Assessor Prop 13

decisionOptions.option: Hold to Expiration (2030–2035) & Re-Lease / Re-Tenant to Replacement QSR
decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: Low to Moderate — binary lease rollover risk; vacancy halts rent while property taxes, insurance, and maintenance revert to landlord.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: Moderate to High ONLY if site holds grandfathered drive-thru zoning and strong arterial traffic capable of attracting a stronger replacement QSR at higher market rent.
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Unverified downtime duration, substantial TI/re-imaging/demolition costs, leasing commissions, and shrinking lender appetite as WALT approaches zero.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: Severe if expiration coincides with a recession, credit crunch, or major LA disaster when restaurant expansion pauses.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Verified in-place rent is materially below Central LA market rent, site enjoys grandfathered drive-thru scarcity, and owner holds ample liquid carry reserves.
decisionOptions.sourceLabel: JACK FY2025 10-K (Lease Terms) & CA DIR AB 1228

decisionOptions.option: Hold to Expiration & Reposition / Sell to Developer (TOC / AB 2011 / DTLA 2040)
decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: Moderate — dense Central LA land can act as an inflation backstop, subject to zoning, entitlement, and interest-rate cycles.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: Highest long-term upside IF private ZIMAS review confirms TOC Tier 3–4 or AB 2011 ministerial multifamily eligibility near Metro D Line / transit hubs.
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Entitlement complexity, Measure ULA transfer tax dampening developer bids >$5.4M inside LA City, elevated post-2025 wildfire construction costs, and AB 2011 commercial-tenant relocation obligations.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: High illiquidity in real estate downturns; CGS Alquist-Priolo fault, liquefaction, or Phase I environmental findings can impair redevelopment feasibility.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Offline ZIMAS & land-broker valuation confirm unencumbered land value approaches or exceeds leased-fee QSR value and owner has a multi-decade, low-leverage horizon.
decisionOptions.sourceLabel: CA Legislature AB 2011, LA City Planning & LA Metro D Line

decisionOptions.wealthPreservation: Low to Moderate — introduces debt service against a single QSR tenant facing negative SSS and elevated leverage; lenders shorten amortization to match remaining WALT.
decisionOptions.growthOpportunity: Moderate — extracts tax-deferred cash to diversify, but borrowing off a 4.91% 10-Yr Treasury base risks thin or negative leverage.
decisionOptions.bauRisks: Refinancing wall prior to 2030–2035 expiry, DSCR covenant stress if tenant vacates, higher interest burden.
decisionOptions.blackSwanRisks: Debt leverage amplifies equity wipeout risk if an earthquake, wildfire, or tenant bankruptcy interrupts rent.
decisionOptions.bestWhen: Generally UNFAVORABLE unless lease is first extended to long WALT and conservative leverage preserves strong DSCR.
decisionOptions.sourceLabel: U.S. Treasury Par Yield Curve (Nov 24, 2026) & JACK Q3 FY26 10-Q

missingInfoQA.question: Who is the exact legal tenant and guarantor — Jack in the Box Inc. (or SPV), or an independent franchisee LLC?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: FY2025 10-K shows 1,585 of 2,136 JACK stores (74.2%) are leased by Jack in the Box from third-party landlords (mostly subleased to franchisees), while 387 (18.1%) are direct franchisee sites.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Which category this specific Central LA lease falls into, and whether any corporate guaranty survived past assignments/refranchising.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Determines default risk, bankruptcy recovery, and buyer cap rate.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Commission a private real estate attorney to review the executed Lease, all Amendments, Assignments, Estoppels, and Guaranty instruments offline.

missingInfoQA.question: What is the exact primary expiration date (within 2030–2035), renewal option schedule, option rent formula, and latest written notice deadline?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: JACK standard leases run 20 years initially with 1–20 years of unilateral tenant renewal options; prompt specifies 2030–2035 expiration window.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Exact month/day of expiration, how many options remain, whether option rent is fixed, CPI, or FMV, and exact written notice deadline.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Dictates timing of short-lease valuation cliff and prevents accidental forfeiture of negotiation leverage.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Extract exact dates in the Private Lease Abstract and reconcile against an audited Notice Calendar with advance reminders.

missingInfoQA.question: Is the lease Absolute NNN, NN, or a Ground Lease — and does it contain a Prop 13 reassessment cap, ROFR, or Go-Dark clause?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: 565 of 2,136 JACK units sit on ground-leased land; Prop 13 reassesses LA County property upon change of ownership (1% base + voted bonds).
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Landlord roof/structure obligations, whether tenant absorbs post-sale Prop 13 tax jump, whether tenant holds a ROFR/ROFO, or whether tenant can go dark while paying rent.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: HIGH — A Prop 13 tax cap reduces buyer NOI and purchase price; a ROFR can disrupt 1031 exchange timelines.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Attorney lease abstract audit of Expense Pass-Through, Property Tax, Maintenance, ROFR/ROFO, and Default/Go-Dark articles.

missingInfoQA.question: What are the subject store's actual annual gross sales, trend since AB 1228 ($20/hr wage), and rent-to-sales occupancy ratio?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: Systemwide JACK franchise AUV fell from $1,949K (FY24) to $1,874K (FY25); franchise SSS was -4.3% (FY25), -7.0% (Q1 FY26), -1.2% (Q3 FY26); 86 stores closed in FY25 (51 under 'JACK on Track').
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Whether this Central LA store is high-volume/healthy or an underperforming closure candidate.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Strong unit sales support blend-and-extend; weak sales with high rent burden signal closure/non-renewal risk.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Check lease for annual sales reporting rights (mandatory if percentage rent clause exists); request store sales during renewal talks; review anonymized broker foot-traffic reports offline.

missingInfoQA.question: Is the parcel legally inside the incorporated City of Los Angeles, or in an adjacent city / unincorporated LA County?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: Measure ULA (4.0% > $5.4M; 5.5% ≥ $10.9M after Jun 30, 2026) and LA City Base Transfer Tax ($2.25/$500) apply ONLY inside incorporated City of Los Angeles (Culver City & Santa Monica have distinct city transfer taxes).
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Exact municipal boundary of the confidential parcel.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Crossing the $5.4M Measure ULA threshold inside LA City imposes 4.0% tax on the entire GROSS sale price (non-deferrable even in a §1031 exchange).
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Check confidential APN privately on LA County Assessor Portal and LA City ZIMAS.

missingInfoQA.question: What are the 1-, 3-, and 5-mile Census tract demographics, arterial AADT traffic counts, nearest LAUSD schools, and QSR drive-thru competitors?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: City of LA averages $81,939 median HH income, 16.5% poverty, 8,304 pop/sq mi, and -0.9% YoY population change (Jan 2026 CA DOF). Central LA neighborhoods vary widely tract-by-tract.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Exact Census tract income/population trend, daytime worker density, arterial VPD count, grandfathered drive-thru status, and nearby rival or sibling Jack in the Box locations.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: HIGH — Governs both tenant renewal willingness and replacement tenant demand if Jack in the Box exits.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Offline secure geocoding using data.census.gov tract tables, Caltrans/LADOT traffic counts, CDE School Dashboard, and a confidential competitor survey.

missingInfoQA.question: What is the exact zoning, lot square footage, TOC Tier (1–4), AB 2011 eligibility, and vacant land value floor?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: LA Metro D Line Sec. 1 opened May 8, 2026; Measure JJJ TOC and CA AB 2011 allow high-density residential on qualifying commercial/transit corridors.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Lot dimensions, zoning designation, distance to Metro station, freeway 500-ft buffer (AB 2011 HVAC rule), and unencumbered land value per sq ft.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: HIGH — If underlying land value approaches leased-fee QSR value, holding through lease expiry carries significantly lower downside.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Private lookup on LA City ZIMAS (including AB 2011 & TOC eligibility tabs) plus a confidential land-value opinion from an LA urban infill land broker.

missingInfoQA.question: What is the owner's adjusted tax basis, cumulative depreciation taken, holding entity (individual, trust, LLC, partnership), and estate/Prop 19 objective?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: Federal capital-gain, unrecaptured §1250, and NIIT rules must be assessed against the owner’s facts; California generally taxes capital gains as ordinary income. Published rules do not establish this owner’s rate or liability.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Actual realized gain, CPA-determined unrecaptured §1250 component, existing debt/prepayment penalty, taxable income/NIIT facts, and total net-worth concentration in this asset.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Sale proceeds and tax treatment cannot be compared with a hold/renewal case until the CPA verifies the owner-specific tax inputs; no direction is inferred.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Confidential CPA tax projection using latest tax return/Form 4562 depreciation schedule and estate counsel review of trust/entity documents.

missingInfoQA.question: What exact cap rates and purchase prices will real buyers pay TODAY (at current WALT) vs. AFTER a 10–15 year blend-and-extend?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: U.S. 10-Year Treasury yielded 4.91% on Nov 24, 2026 (FRED DGS10: 4.92% on Nov 23, 2026); lenders tighten amortization on short remaining lease terms.
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Actual Southern California QSR buyer cap rate spread, short-lease discount in basis points, and whether expected sale price falls below or above the $5.4M Measure ULA threshold.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: CRITICAL — Quantifies the exact dollar benefit of extending before selling vs. exiting early.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Solicit 3 independent confidential Broker Opinions of Value (BOVs) from active Southern California NNN QSR brokers (with closed LA comps and explicit WALT sensitivity).

missingInfoQA.question: What is the parcel's exact CGS fault/liquefaction zone, FEMA flood zone, CAL FIRE 2025 LRA fire zone, Phase I ESA environmental status, and current insurance coverage?
missingInfoQA.whatWeKnow: LA Basin has 60% 30-yr probability of ≥M6.7 earthquake (USGS UCERF3); Jan 2025 LA wildfires destroyed 16,259 structures and led to CDI Order 2025-1 ($1B FAIR Plan assessment).
missingInfoQA.whatWeDoNotKnow: Whether the parcel sits in an Alquist-Priolo/liquefaction/SFHA/VHFHSZ zone, whether soil/groundwater contamination exists, building condition, and whether earthquake/loss-of-rent insurance is carried.
missingInfoQA.decisionImpact: HIGH — Uninsured seismic/environmental exposure can cause severe equity loss in a Black Swan event or derail buyer financing in escrow.
missingInfoQA.discoveryMethod: Run offline APN checks in CGS EQ Zapp, FEMA MSC, and CAL FIRE LRA FHSZ viewer; review tenant COI with a commercial insurance broker; commission private Phase I ESA & PCA.

siteSuggestions.title: Encrypted Local-Only Private Workspace File (.enc.json via Web Crypto AES-GCM)
siteSuggestions.description: Upgrade the W-02 browser calculator and W-03 decision board to optionally save/load an AES-256-GCM passphrase-encrypted local file so the owner and advisors can exchange verified private scenarios offline without ever exposing plaintext PII or publishing private inputs.
siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Eliminates manual re-entry across advisor sessions while keeping GitHub Pages 100% anonymous.
siteSuggestions.privacyImpact: Positive — 100% client-side Web Crypto API; zero network upload.
siteSuggestions.prerequisites: Owner approval of local passphrase workflow with CPA/attorney.

siteSuggestions.title: Offline Local-Only Census Tract & ZIMAS Import Bridge (CSV/JSON)
siteSuggestions.description: Add a local file loader to W-01 that ingests an anonymized CSV exported offline from data.census.gov (tract-level 2015–19 vs. 2020–24 ACS trends) and renders side-by-side comparisons against LA City and LA County strictly in browser memory.
siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Replaces regional proxies with verified tract-level multi-year evidence without ever committing parcel identifiers to the repo.
siteSuggestions.privacyImpact: Safe when restricted to client-side memory and stripping tract FIPS IDs before printing.
siteSuggestions.prerequisites: Offline geocoding of confidential APN to select consistent Census tracts.

siteSuggestions.title: Monte Carlo & Correlated Tail-Risk Simulator (Cap Rate × Downtime × Disaster Shocks)

siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Quantifies downside wealth preservation (P10 tail risk) alongside median growth (P50).
siteSuggestions.prerequisites: Verified private NOI, tax basis, and 3 broker BOV quotes to calibrate distributions.
siteSuggestions.sourceLabel: USGS UCERF3 & U.S. Treasury Yield Curve

siteSuggestions.title: Comparable Sales Ledger & Empirical Short-Lease Discount Back-Tester
siteSuggestions.description: Add a local-only comparable sales ledger (WALT remaining, cap rate, corporate vs. franchisee guaranty, LA submarket, Measure ULA impact, sale date) to fit an empirical WALT-vs-Cap-Rate curve and back-test model predictions against real closed LA QSR trades.
siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Replaces broker anecdotes with auditable closed-transaction evidence.
siteSuggestions.privacyImpact: Low risk when storing anonymized market comps separate from subject parcel.
siteSuggestions.prerequisites: Collection of verified closed Southern California QSR NNN comps from brokers/public deeds.
siteSuggestions.sourceLabel: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance Measure ULA FAQ

siteSuggestions.title: Quarterly SEC EDGAR Filing Watchlist & Credit Red-Line Tracker
siteSuggestions.description: Add a repeatable quarterly SEC EDGAR review workflow to ingest Jack in the Box's forthcoming FY2026 Form 10-K and FY2027 Form 10-Qs, tracking SSS, closures, franchise rental revenue, and leverage covenants against predefined action triggers.
siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Ensures sale/renewal timing adapts quickly to corporate turnaround or credit deterioration.

siteSuggestions.title: Measure ULA Cliff Optimizer & §1031 Replacement Comparison Module

siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Prevents costly pricing errors near LA's $5.4M / $10.9M transfer-tax cliffs and sharpens §1031 comparison.

siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Accelerates Gates 1–4 while preventing unnecessary sharing of personal tax details with brokers.

siteSuggestions.sourceLabel: CA Dept. of Insurance FAIR Plan Orders

siteSuggestions.title: Versioned Gate-5 Pre-Commitment Audit Memo Generator

siteSuggestions.decisionBenefit: Enforces disciplined governance and prevents premature commitments before verified inputs exist.
